_comment: Product/Service Codes set aside by default in the Misuse Protection screen. These identify purchases of a *named proprietary license* -- where a single offer is the structurally expected outcome, not a competition-avoidance signal, because only one vendor sells the product (nobody but COMSOL sells COMSOL licenses). Set-aside awards are still counted and shown behind a toggle; they are never deleted from the analysis. Deliberately NOT excluded: labor/support-services codes (DA01, D311), hardware-plus-bundled-license products (7B*, 7C*, 7E*, 7G*, 7K*), and laboratory equipment (6640, 6695) -- those have real competitive markets, so a single bid there is worth the same second look as anywhere else.
label: Proprietary software licensing
